p2_6_route_budget_reduction.policy: No platform domain-route growth above the verified AST domain-route budget. Infrastructure/provenance routes remain visible in the raw inventory and may be excluded only through the explicit method-and-normalized-path allowlist.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.ui3b_ui4_note: Budget deliberately raised 570->572 for two UI-alignment BFF routes (/api/v1/features runtime flag registry; /api/v1/fields/{field_id}/readiness facade over data-completeness). Documented raise via the sanctioned guard path, not silent growth.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.ui27_ui35_note: Budget raised 572->575 for UI27-UI35 Field Workspace BFF facades (imagery/weather/timeline/priority), owned+documented.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.note: 591->592: Phase E decision-evidence BFF proxy (GET agronomic-evidence; authz + fail-closed pass-through; decision-service owns the truth).
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.wx_i1_hourly_recommendation_note: 597->598: WX-I1 hourly energy-aware MPC recommendation (POST /api/v1/fields/{field_id}/irrigation/mpc/hourly-recommendation). bff-orchestrator; owned+documented; hourly sibling of the daily irrigation_mpc_recommendation — composes platform-owned SoR (water_ledger, canonical_irrigation_capability_graphs, irrigation_executability_gates) with the weather-engine native hourly ETc product; fail-closed; recommendation-only (execution_allowed=False). No owner service exists for this composition (it joins platform-owned canonical DB truth), so it correctly lives in the BFF.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.closed_loop_reconcile_note: 598->599: WX-I1 closed-loop reconcile (POST /api/v1/irrigation/executions/reconcile). bff-orchestrator; owned+documented; server-owned measured-as-applied → water_ledger reconciliation (v184); tenant from JWT; idempotent; measurement-only, no actuation.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.s3_s11_truth_closure_note: 611->616: S3 historical weather SoR (ingest/read/coverage) plus S11 ERP reconciliation ledger (record/list). Platform owns these tenant-bound cross-domain truth ledgers; both are append-only, idempotent and fail-closed.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.simple_farm_book_recovery_note: 616->623: recovered the previously delivered simple farmer book as a BFF/domain layer over the existing Farm Ledger boundary: parties, entries, monthly/balances and CSV/PDF export. No new service or ERP writer.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.v8_05_pr2_process_date_note: 625->626: V8-05 PR2 single-scene process-date proxy (POST /api/v1/fields/{field_id}/imagery/process-date). compute-store; target_owner raster-service; the single-scene sibling of the existing field_imagery_backfill_proxy — same facade pattern (field-ownership + geometry_revision authz at the platform boundary, HTTP pass-through to raster-service which owns the compute/store). Makes date processing an explicit user action after decoupling it from side-effect-free date selection. Documented raise via the sanctioned guard path, not silent growth.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.raw_route_inventory_policy: All statically declared platform GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes remain visible in the raw inventory.
p2_6_route_budget_reduction.infrastructure_budget_policy: Infrastructure/provenance routes are excluded only through the explicit method-and-normalized-path allowlist using exact HTTP method plus conservatively normalized literal path. Every allowlist entry must exist in the sahool-platform inventory; non-literal route declarations fail closed.
